outline: 本課程介紹機率學的基本概念與應用，包括集合、排列組合、機率理論、條件機率、隨機變數、累積分佈函數、期望值與變異數等內容。課程涵蓋離散型與連續型機率分配、聯合分配、隨機變數的函數變換，以及順序統計量與基礎統計量的介紹。此外，學生將學習柴比雪夫不等式、大數定律與中央極限定理等重要定理，並透過期中考試與期末考試進行學習評估。This course introduces fundamental concepts and applications of probability, including sets, permutations and combinations, probability theory, conditional probability, random variables, cumulative distribution functions, and measures such as expectations and variances. The course covers discrete and continuous probability distributions, joint distributions, transformations of random variables, order statistics, and basic statistical measures. Additionally, students will study Chebyshev’s inequality, the law of large numbers, and the central limit theorem, with learning progress assessed through midterm and final examinations.
schedule:
第1週	集合與排列組合	Sets, Permutations, and Combinations
第2週	機率概論與條件機率	Introduction to Probability and Conditional Probability
第3週	條件機率與獨立性，隨機變數的概念	Conditional Probability, Independence, and Random Variables
第4週	隨機變數與累積分佈函數	Random Variables and Cumulative Distribution Functions
第5週	期望值、變異數與動差生成函數	Expectation, Variance, and Moment Generating Functions
第6週	特徵函數與隨機變數的函數變換	Characteristic Functions and Transformations of Random Variables
第7週	離散型機率分配 (Part 1)	Discrete Probability Distributions (Part 1)
第8週	離散型機率分配 (Part 2)	Discrete Probability Distributions (Part 2)
第9週	期中考試	Midterm Exam
第10週	連續型機率分配 (Part 1)	Continuous Probability Distributions (Part 1)
第11週	連續型機率分配 (Part 2)	Continuous Probability Distributions (Part 2)
第12週	聯合機率分配與條件分配	Joint Probability Distributions and Conditional Distributions
第13週	期望值的性質	Properties of Expectation
第14週	期望值性質與二元常態分配	Properties of Expectation and Bivariate Normal Distribution
第15週	二維隨機變數的函數變換	Transformations of Bivariate Random Variables
第16週	順序統計量與基本統計量	Order Statistics and Basic Statistical Measures
第17週	柴比雪夫不等式、大數定律與中央極限定理	Chebyshev's Inequality, Law of Large Numbers, and Central Limit Theorem
第18週	期末考試	Final Exam
